duel.jaymoskingdoms.under_way.0: We're already at it, %s. Guard yourself.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.under_way.1: Eyes on me, %s. This isn't finished.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.elsewhere.0: You're in a bout with another, %s. Finish that first.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.busy.0: I'm crossing blades with someone, %s. Wait your turn.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.busy.1: Not now, %s. I have a bout in hand.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.0: Not like this, %s. Mend first, and so will I.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.1: We're neither of us fit for it, %s. Another time.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.not_yours.0: I cross blades with my own pupils, %s. Take up our ways first.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.not_yours.1: You're none of mine, %s. Join the school, then ask.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.tomorrow.0: Once a day is plenty, %s. Come back tomorrow.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.start.0: To the first fall, %s. No killing.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.start.1: On guard, %s. Only the form, never the death.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.challenge.0: %1$s! A student of %2$s asks a bout with you. Speak to me if you dare.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.challenge.1: You carry yourself well, %1$s. Show me, in the bout. I walk the road of %2$s.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.challenge.rival.0: %1$s of %3$s! My school has a word for yours. Speak to me, and settle it.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.challenge.rival.1: So you follow %3$s, %1$s. We of %2$s would see what that is worth.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.won.cold.0: A lucky blow, %s. Don't let it swell your head.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.won.cold.1: Hmph. You win this one, %s. Once.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.lost.warm.0: Well tried, %s. Here, let me see to that. Again, when you're ready.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.lost.warm.1: Don't take it hard, %s. That was a good bout.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.lost.plain.0: The bout is mine, %s. Learn from it.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.lost.plain.1: You fell first, %s. Come back stronger.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.lost.cold.1: On the floor again, %s. Your school should be ashamed.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.draw.warm.0: Neither of us gave way, %s. Well matched.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.draw.warm.1: A fine draw, %s. We'll finish it another day.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.draw.cold.0: You ran out the time, %s. A coward's draw.
duel.jaymoskingdoms.end.draw.cold.1: No winner. You wasted my morning, %s.
